_: Bria's video upscaler. One flat rate per second whatever it is asked for, which is rarer than it should be.

bria/video/increase-resolution.description: Doubles or quadruples a clip at one flat rate per second. Licensed training data, which is the reason to reach for Bria.

pricing.note: fal publishes a flat $0.14 per second of output. It has no length control: the output is as long as what it was given, so the hold assumes fifteen seconds.
